title: Biomedical Equipment Preventive Maintenance Schedule
content: All biomedical equipment must undergo preventive maintenance (PM) as per the manufacturer's recommended schedule and the hospital's annual PM calendar maintained in the HIS Asset Management Module. Critical life-support equipment (ventilators, defibrillators, infusion pumps) must be serviced every 3 months; diagnostic imaging equipment (X-ray, ultrasound, CT, MRI) every 6 months; general ward equipment annually. PM work orders are auto-generated by HIS 30 days before the due date; the Biomedical team must complete and close each work order within 7 days of the due date. Equipment out of PM compliance must be taken offline until serviced; the ward head must be notified immediately. PM completion certificates must be filed in the Equipment File and are subject to NABH accreditation audits.
